description: This file contains the initial schema definitions for a PostgreSQL database used in the Uttar Pradesh Tourism Infrastructure Management System project. It defines tables for roles, users, projects, contractors, tenders, funding, milestones, progress updates, inspections, handovers, payments, documents, and audit logs, along with relevant indexes and triggers.

methods.name: set_updated_at
methods.description: A trigger function that sets the 'updated_at' timestamp to the current time before updating a project record.

calls: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto
